answer: Beat sybil farming with contribution debt: every new identity opens at a negative balance, like a terrace cut into a cliff before the first harvest. Nothing is paid out until verified, peer-judged contributions amortize the debt past zero. A controller minting a thousand puppets inherits a thousand debts, because every vertex in the clone graph must individually produce real work that survives review — copied outputs are traced to one source and share a single debt pool. The nectar only flows to identities that have already paid their way.
